description: This file defines CLI commands for managing skills in the openclaw project, including listing, searching, installing, updating, and inspecting skills via a command-line interface.

methods.name: loadSkillsStatusReport
methods.description: Loads the skills status report asynchronously by resolving configuration and workspace directory, then calling buildWorkspaceSkillStatus.

methods.name: runSkillsAction
methods.description: Executes a report rendering function with the skills status report, handling errors and output.

methods.name: resolveActiveWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves and returns the active workspace directory based on current configuration.

methods.name: registerSkillsCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands related to skills, including list, search, install, update, info, check, and default listing.
